color.$description: Semantic tier, DARK theme. AUTHORED dark values (BR-BW-TOK-002): each token's dark value is chosen deliberately for the dark surface, NEVER computed by inverting or filtering the light value. Same token names as semantic.light.tokens.json. Accent/status roles shift to lighter, slightly-desaturated ramp steps so they keep AA contrast on a dark surface rather than glowing. Derived tokens carry their live color-mix expression in $extensions.bw.derived with dark-tuned constants (and, for the strong/subtle tiers, a flipped mix direction); $value stays the resolved default and the regression baseline (docs/DESIGN.md section 3).

surface.$description: 0.4.0 polish: lifted from gray.950 (0.145), whose derived sunken sat near L 0.11, an undifferentiated void; the graphite base gives a legible three-step sunken/surface/raised ladder.

surface-sunken.$description: Resolved literal of the 76% mix over the 0.4.0 graphite surface.

surface-raised.$description: Resolved literal of the 93%-toward-white mix over the 0.4.0 graphite surface.

surface-overlay.$description: Authored, not derived: a scrim is dark-over-content in both themes; deriving from surface-inverse (= fg, near-white in dark) would yield a light wash.

fg.$description: 0.4.0 polish: dimmed from gray.50 (0.985); maximum-white body text glares on a dark canvas. Measures 15.30:1 on the graphite surface, far above the 7:1 heading floor.

fg-muted.$description: 0.4.0 polish: mix raised 67% to 72% to companion the dimmed fg; measures 7.58:1 on surface and 6.68:1 on raised.

border-control.$description: Input/control boundary. The divider border token stays subtle; controls need a WCAG 1.4.11 compliant boundary (measured 3.38:1 against the 0.4.0 graphite surface).

accent-subtle.$description: 0.4.0 polish: mix lowered 40% to 30% so selection and active-nav recede behind content instead of outshining it; nav-item-active-text gains contrast on the darker tint (14.47:1).

danger-subtle.$description: 0.4.0 polish: mix lowered 41% to 26% so the dark tint whispers like its light counterpart; danger-fg measures 7.22:1 on it. A literal (the red.950 alias no longer matches).

danger-border.$description: Tinted badge/alert border for the danger intent; clears the black-mixed subtle tint by delta-L 0.184.

warning-subtle.$description: Literal, not an amber ramp alias: black is hue-powerless in the mix, so the resolved hue stays the warning base's 70, not the ramp's 46. 0.4.0 polish: mix lowered 36% to 22%; warning-fg measures 10.77:1 on it.

warning-border.$description: Tinted badge/alert border for the warning intent; clears the black-mixed subtle tint by delta-L 0.254.

success-subtle.$description: 0.4.0 polish: mix lowered 37% to 23%; success-fg measures 10.19:1 on it. A literal (the green.950 alias no longer matches).

success-border.$description: Tinted badge/alert border for the success intent; clears the black-mixed subtle tint by delta-L 0.232.

info-subtle.$description: Literal, not the cyan.950 alias: black is hue-powerless in the mix, so the resolved hue stays the info base's 220, not the ramp's 230. 0.4.0 polish: mix lowered 42% to 26%; info-fg measures 9.53:1 on it.

info-border.$description: Tinted badge/alert border for the info intent; clears the black-mixed subtle tint by delta-L 0.209.

skeleton-bg.$description: Resolved literal of the 82%-toward-white mix over the 0.4.0 sunken canvas.

state.$description: Interactive-state tokens, DARK theme (DESIGN.md section 4.6). Overlays flip to translucent white so transient feedback lightens the dark surface beneath. Same names as semantic.light.tokens.json.

elevation.$description: Elevation ramp, DARK theme (DESIGN.md section 5). AUTHORED, not derived: shadows vanish on dark surfaces, so alpha rises and every level from 1 adds a faint inset top highlight to fake ambient light (0.4.0: levels 1 and 2 gained fainter highlights than 3+, so dark cards get depth instead of outlines only).
